high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of an article from the Deccan Herald newspaper website. The headline reads: "20 stray dogs found shot dead in Telangana." Below the headline, there is a brief summary stating that an eyewitness has claimed that one person who came in a car is the one who committed the crime, based on preliminary investigation. The article is attributed to PTI (Press Trust of India) and was last updated on 16 February 2024, at 21:51 IST (Indian Standard Time). There are options to follow the publication on social media platforms like Google+ and other sharing
